## Install

**Mac** (Apple Silicon M1 or newer, macOS 14+): download the `.dmg`, open it and drag **TDPlay AI Video Render**
onto Applications. The app is free and not registered with Apple, so the first time macOS blocks it: open
**System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**. On its first launch the app sets
itself up (about 1 GB, a few minutes).

**Windows** (Windows 11, AMD Radeon RX 7000 / RX 9000 or NVIDIA RTX): download `TDPlay-AI-Video-Render-Setup-….exe`
and run it. If Windows says "Windows protected your PC": **More info → Run anyway**. During the installation a
window downloads Python and PyTorch for your graphics card (several GB).

Then open the app's **Models** tab to download the video model (30–55 GB). See the README for everything else.
